'''Cresken''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] stationed on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], where he asked a fellow Imperial to deal with stealth-equipped [[Exchange]] [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]].<ref name="TOR" />
